pages.text: Hold leather and right-click a $(item)Tanning Rack$(). The scraper makes one pass across the hide; click as it crosses each dark patch, in order.
pages.title: The Tanning Rack

pages.text: A patch missed (or passed by) might tear the hide, likelier with each miss, leaving only $(item)Leather Scraps$() (four make a leather again). Scrape it clean and you have $(item)Refined Leather$().
pages.title: Scraping
